cases.task: Choose the safe browser rule when named SSE application frames can evolve their JSON payload shape across protocol versions.

required_facts.text: ready, event, page, and terminal_error are application protocol frames whose payload fields affect durable cursor acceptance or operator evidence.
Every named frame must declare the supported schema version before the client changes cursor or renders evidence.
A missing or unsupported schema version must close fail-closed while preserving the last accepted cursor.
